summary: A Kinect hardware showcase whose intended input is inseparable from the game.

entries.title: Kinect Adventures!

emulation.notes: No dependable Kinect-capable Xbox 360 emulation route is currently verified; Xenia's Kinect support remains an open feature request.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox 360 output and tracking on real Kinect hardware.

primary.why: The game was built around the Xbox 360 Kinect camera and shipped as a Kinect pack-in. There is no verified modern port, and Xenia's Kinect-support request remains open, so original Xbox 360 hardware is presently the only dependable way to play the intended game.
primary.how_to_play: Use an Xbox 360, the original Kinect sensor, its required power/USB arrangement, and enough clear floor space for full-body tracking. Treat the disc and working sensor as preservation hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Original 720p-era console output with the required motion camera.
all_releases.reason: primary and only dependable route: the Kinect input is core game logic, not a replaceable controller option.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no competing port; hardware availability is the limiting factor.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or conventional-controller version exists. A video capture or controller-mapped approximation is not equivalent to playing the Kinect activities.
